mapper.select: SELECT stock_code FROM stock_master WHERE is_managed = FALSE AND is_trading_halt = FALSE AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY stock_code
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_master SET is_trading_halt = TRUE, updated_at = now() WHERE is_trading_halt = FALSE AND deleted_at IS NULL AND stock_code NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT stock_code FROM price_history WHERE trade_datetime >= #{cutoff} )

UPDATE stock_master SET is_trading_halt = FALSE, updated_at = now() WHERE is_trading_halt = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL AND stock_code IN ( SELECT DISTINCT stock_code FROM price_history WHERE trade_datetime >= #{cutoff} )
